summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any code or tests (per your instructions). Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py with Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs; UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and now yields one Text with click spans applied last; Opacity merges the blended color into the existing style, preserving metadata; the layout resolver Edge already had size/min_size/fraction, so it was left unchanged; docs/reference/tabs.md added; tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and added in tests/widgets/test_tabs.py (with __init__.py). Nothing is committed. Caveats: tests are unrun, so failures are possible; letter search only accepts single-character keys; with duplicate names the bar's full-list index can diverge from the displayed-tab highlight, as the spec literally describes; the optional sandbox demo was skipped.
